input.instruction: In /testbed, find the code implementing the `codegraph node` command / codegraph_node MCP tool, especially handling of the `-f`/file option and where it outputs the code snippet ("Location:", "definitions named"). Report file paths, line numbers and the relevant code verbatim.

content.content: {"summary":"The `codegraph node` CLI is a thin wrapper. It builds args and calls the `codegraph_node` tool through `ToolHandler.execute`. `handleNode` in src/mcp/tools.ts does the work. With `file` and no symbol, it reads the file. With a symbol, `file` and `line` only narrow overloaded matches. `formatNodeDetails` writes the 'Location:' line and the code snippet. The 'definitions named' header is in `handleNode`.","findings":["src/bin/codegraph.ts:1370-1436: `program.command('node [name]')` defines `-f, --file <file>` (line ~1383), `--offset`, `--limit` and `--symbols-only`. `name` is optional so that `node -f file` works (#1044).","src/bin/codegraph.ts:~1410-1420 is the `-f` handling. If `options.file` is set, `args.file = options.file` and `if (name && name !== options.file) args.symbol = name;`. Otherwise a name containing '/' or '\\\\' becomes `args.file`. Otherwise `args.symbol = name; args.includeCode = true;`. Line 1428 calls `handler.execute('codegraph_node', args)` and the result is printed with console.log.","src/mcp/tools.ts:639: the `codegraph_node` tool definition. src/mcp/tools.ts:1484: `case 'codegraph_node': return await this.handleNode(args);`","src/mcp/tools.ts:3709-3830: `handleNode`. It sets `const fileHint = typeof args.file === 'string' && args.file.trim() ? args.file.trim() : undefined;`.","src/mcp/tools.ts:~3724: file read mode is `if (!symbolRaw && fileHint) { return this.handleFileView(cg, fileHint, { offset, limit, symbolsOnly }); }`.","src/mcp/tools.ts:~3735-3752: when `matches.length > 1 && (fileHint || lineHint !== undefined)`, matches are narrowed with `byFile = narrowed.filter((n) => norm(n.filePath).endsWith(fh) || norm(n.filePath).includes(fh))`. The narrowing is only applied if `byFile` is non-empty. A `line` hint then picks the definition whose body contains that line, or the nearest start.","src/mcp/tools.ts:~3755: a single match returns `this.textResult(this.truncateOutput(await this.renderNodeSection(cg, matches[0]!, includeCode)))`.","src/mcp/tools.ts:3775: `const header = `**${matches.length} definitions named \"${symbol}\"**`;`. Without `includeCode`, lines 3776-3780 return a list of `- \\`name\\` (kind) — filePath:startLine`. With `includeCode`, bodies are packed up to BODY_BUDGET=12000 and HARD_CAP=16, rendered through `renderNodeSection`.","src/mcp/tools.ts:3821: the remainder hint says 'Call codegraph_node again with `file` ... or `line` — do NOT Read it.'","src/mcp/tools.ts:4645-4670: `formatNodeDetails(node, code, outline)` builds the output. It emits `**Location:** ${node.filePath}${location}` at line 4648, with `location = node.startLine ? `:${node.startLine}` : ''`. It then adds the Signature and a short docstring (under 200 chars). The snippet is added at ~4665-4668 as `lines.push('', '```' + node.language, numbered, '```');`, where `numbered = numberSourceLines(code, node.startLine)`. `numberSourceLines` is in src/utils.ts, near line 91. For container kinds an outline is shown instead (see ~line 84)."],"confidence":0.85}

content.text: Likely includeCode isn't set when file given.

input.instruction: In /testbed/src/mcp/tools.ts check handleNode around lines 3709-3760: when a symbol has several matches and file hint narrows to one, ensure includeCode is respected (single match renders code with includeCode). Report if includeCode defaults false in handleNode and whether it would show code for the narrowed match.

content.content: {"summary":"In handleNode, includeCode defaults to false. A file hint that narrows several matches to one does respect includeCode. Code is shown for the narrowed match only if the caller passes includeCode: true.","findings":["tools.ts:3714: `const includeCode = args.includeCode === true;`, so it is false unless the caller passes true. The schema at tools.ts:648-652 also declares `default: false`.","tools.ts:3733-3752: when there are several matches and a file or line hint is given, `matches` is narrowed. The file hint matches by path suffix or substring. If the hint matches nothing, it is ignored.","tools.ts:3763-3764: if `matches.length === 1` after narrowing, it calls `renderNodeSection(cg, matches[0], includeCode)`. The same flag is passed through, so the narrowed single match is rendered like any single-match lookup.","tools.ts:3971-3985: `renderNodeSection` fetches code with `cg.getCode` only when includeCode is true. Container kinds (class, interface, struct and similar) get a structural outline instead of the full body.","Result: with includeCode true, the narrowed match shows its code, or an outline if it is a container kind. With includeCode false or omitted, it shows metadata and trail only, with no code.","The multi-match path at tools.ts:3776-3779 is separate. It only prints the 'Re-query with includeCode: true' list when includeCode is false and several matches remain after narrowing."],"confidence":0.93}
